answer: The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the thread of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The spiral holds work receipts rather than names, so the shale of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
